text.p: The average yields at auctions of three-, six-, nine- and 12-month treasury bills slipped from the last sale on March 6, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.

Three-month bills slipped to 24.24 from 25.97 percent, six-month bills edged down to 30.18 percent from 31.51 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 32.95 from 34.88 percent, and 12-month bills dropped to 35.60 percent from 38.00 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 6.00 million UAH 6.00 million UAH
Amount sold 4.62 million UAH 6.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.36 million UAH 5.63 million UAH
The central bank sold 46,208 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 14,802 were competitive and 31,406 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 12.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 9.80 million UAH 9.80 million UAH
Amount sold 8.17 million UAH 9.80 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.10 million UAH 8.47 million UAH
The central bank sold 81,720 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 1,000 were competitive and 80,720 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 12.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 25.00 million UAH 25.00 million UAH
Amount sold 12.53 million UAH 18.42 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.05 million UAH 14.61 million UAH
The central bank sold 125,291 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 62,468 were competitive and 62,823 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 12.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 31.00 million UAH 31.00 million UAH
Amount sold 13.69 million UAH 31.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.11 million UAH 22.48 million UAH
The central bank sold 136,967 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 64,968 were competitive and 71,999 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 12.
